topperMethod.proTip: Never write down decimal rounded figures on the rough sheet. Do direct mental fraction evaluation.

question:
I. x² − 17x + 72 = 0
II. y² − 19y + 90 = 0
options: x = y or relationship cannot be established

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Factoring & 4-Way Comparison)
steps: Equation I: Factors of 72 adding to 17 are 9 and 8 → roots x = +9, +8
Equation II: Factors of 90 adding to 19 are 10 and 9 → roots y = +10, +9
Since x is either smaller than or equal to y in all comparisons: x ≤ y.

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Factor Visualization & Bound Compare)
steps: Both equations have (-, +) signs ⇒ All roots of x and y are positive (+, +)
Notice max(x) = 9 which equals min(y) = 9, and all other x < y.
topperMethod.proTip: When roots share an exact boundary number (here 9), check whether the ranges overlap or merely touch. Here they touch at 9, hence ≤.

question:
I. x² + 13x − 68 = 0
II. y² − 7y − 60 = 0
options: x = y or relationship cannot be established (CND)

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (The 3-Second CND Sign Rule)
steps: Look at the constant terms: -68 in I, -60 in II.
RULE: When both constant terms are negative, both equations MUST have one positive and one negative root.
A pair of (+, -) roots against another (+, -) roots ALWAYS results in CND / No Relation!
Mark option 5 in 2 seconds without touching the pen.
topperMethod.proTip: Look at the signs before even reading the numbers! If both constants are negative, you just earned a free mark in 2 seconds.

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Instant Cube Differences)
steps: Diffs: +1, +8, +27, +64 → Instantly recognize sequence of cubes: 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³
Last digit check: 4 + 5 = 9. Only 239 ends in 9!
topperMethod.proTip: Combine series pattern recognition with last-digit addition to eliminate having to do the full sum.

question: A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and allows a discount of 20% on the marked price. If he earns a profit of ₹180, find the cost price of the article.
questionHi: एक दुकानदार एक वस्तु का मूल्य उसके क्रय मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित करता है और अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की छूट देता है। यदि वह ₹180 का लाभ कमाता है, तो वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Successive Percentage Formula)
topperMethod.proTip: Markup (+a) followed by discount (-b) is simply successive percentage: Net% = a - b - ab/100.

question: The difference between simple interest and compound interest compounded annually on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 15% per annum is ₹270. Find the sum.
questionHi: किसी धनराशि पर 15% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष के लिए साधारण ब्याज और वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच का अंतर ₹270 है। वह धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Direct 2-Year Difference Formula)
topperMethod.proTip: Simplify the fraction (15/100 = 3/20) before squaring to get (9/400). 270 cancels directly with 9 to give 30.

question: A alone can complete a piece of work in 24 days, and B alone can complete the same work in 36 days. They work together for 6 days, and then A leaves. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questionHi: A अकेले किसी काम को 24 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और B अकेले उसी काम को 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। वे 6 दिनों तक एक साथ काम करते हैं, और फिर A काम छोड़ देता है। B शेष काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Total Work = LCM Units)
topperMethod.proTip: Integer units turn fraction subtractions into elementary mental subtraction: 72 - 30 = 42, then 42 / 2 = 21.

question: In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of pulses costing ₹45 per kg and ₹70 per kg respectively, so as to get a mixture worth ₹55 per kg?
questionHi: एक पंसारी को ₹45 प्रति किग्रा और ₹70 प्रति किग्रा वाली दो किस्मों की दालों को किस अनुपात में मिलाना चाहिए, ताकि ₹55 प्रति किग्रा मूल्य का मिश्रण प्राप्त हो सके?

standardMethod.title: Standard Method (Algebraic)
steps: Let x kg of first pulse and y kg of second pulse be mixed.

topperMethod.title: Solve Like a Topper (Alligation Cross)
topperMethod.proTip: Draw the cross in your head. 70-55=15 on the left, 55-45=10 on the right. 15:10 reduces to 3:2.
